heading: Wednesday Night
text: Variable clouds. Patches of river valley fog, mainly east of the Greens. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, except low to mid 60s in the broad valleys west, and around 50 in the cooler hollows east. Winds becoming light, variable to south, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly to partly sunny after any early fog. Chance of showers and thunderstorms, a rising chance mid to late afternoon; a severe storm possible. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. South winds 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 20 mph, except gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, with areas of valley fog late. Showers and thunderstorms likely; a severe storm possible early. Lows in the upper 50s to lower 60s. South winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming west and diminishing late.
